subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support a caller/config-selectable parent-only completion mode that wakes the requester with `deliver:false`, alongside the existing requester-session handoff that may deliver the parent response externally?
rationale: The implementation is correct and demonstrated, but deciding whether OpenClaw should maintain a second durable completion-delivery policy requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Keep current canonical flow
options.body: Close this PR and continue using requester-session handoff plus `sessions_yield` without another persistent routing policy.

options.title: Sponsor the full option
options.body: Reopen or replace this PR with explicit approval for the per-spawn argument, global and per-agent defaults, and persisted restart behavior.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn only
options.body: Reopen a narrowed change that provides explicit caller control without adding long-lived configuration defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep current canonical flow
recommendation.body: Close this PR and continue using requester-session handoff plus `sessions_yield` without another persistent routing policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on requester wake-up and completion delivery makes this person the strongest available owner for the policy decision.
